address: Cardamom Building, 31G Shad Thames, Butlers Wharf, London, SE1 2YR, United Kingdom
bio: An unpretentious Italian restaurant in one of the converted Shad Thames warehouses; the unfussy service suits the style of the place. The seasonally influenced menu uses British produce, with the in-house pasta a particular highlight; dishes are relatively simple but flavours are bold and prices, appealing....
